messages:
Aisha: Hi everyone 1st day here and trying to get my docs workflow sorted. I can view the Company Handbook but I can't find the 'Platform -> Docs Hub' or the template gallery. Where should I be looking and how do I get edit rights for team templates?
Marco: welcome Aisha! :wave: Docs Hub is under the Platform space in Notion. There's a Templates gallery page (Platform / Docs Hub / Templates). If you can't see it, your SSO group might not be in the 'eng-read' permission set yet.
Aisha: Ah ok. I can see Platform but not Docs Hub. Is that an IT ticket?
Marco: Usually devex grants access. Two options: 1) fill the docs-access form (Devex will auto-suggest owners), or 2) DM the page owner if you know them. If it's an SSO group issue, ping IT.
Aisha: If I find a template I want to use (eg Starter PRD or Deploy Runbook), can I just duplicate it and start editing the copy? Or do we prefer forks in a team space?
Marco: You can duplicate any template with Can View. Use the three-dot menu -> Duplicate to workspace -> put in your Team space. For canonical templates (the ones in Team / Playbooks) we ask you to open a small PR-like change request by adding a comment on the template and tagging the owner. If you need to change the original, request edit perms.
Aisha: What's the difference between Starter PRD and Product PRD templates?
Marco: Starter PRD is lightweight (audience, TL;DR, success metrics). Product PRD is more formal and includes a RACI, rollout plan, rollout checklist block, and a dependencies table. Use Starter for exploratory signals, Product PRD for launch planning.
Devex Bot: Quick link: Request Docs Access form: https://forms.redwood.internal/docs-access. Tip: include the page URL and the role you need (viewer/editor/owner) in the note. If you hit an SSO permission wall, include your employee ID.
Aisha: Thanks. Any metadata conventions I should add when creating a new page?
Marco: Yes 5 key props at the top: Owner, Lifecycle (draft|review|stable|archived), Last updated, Component, and Tags. We also use a checkbox property "Uses Template v1" for migration tracking. For runbooks add a 'Severity' field and a 'Recovery steps' block.
Aisha: Who owns the Deploy Runbook template? I might need to tweak it for our service onboarding steps.
Nora: That's me 60A. I own Deploy Runbook. Ping me and I'll add you as an editor for the page. FYI I prefer changes via comments first so we keep history.
Aisha: Great thanks @Nora. One last Q: how do I make sure I'm notified of edits? I want to watch the page but not get noise for minor edits from other teams.
Marco: Use the Watch menu at the top-right and choose 'Watch for edits/comments'. If it's noisy, use the page's 'Watching' options to only get mentions or major updates. Also you can add yourself as a reviewer in the page properties to get fewer alerts.
Aisha: Perfect. I filled the form and DM'd @Nora. Appreciate the rapid help!
Nora: Happy to onboard you. If you want, we can do a 10m screenshare to set the page props and show the template gallery.
Aisha: Yes please 44B. Scheduling now.
